answer: A mint mill cannot share one canopy. Each newcomer claims a single numbered row in a public orchard cadastre and locks 1.04 POA for five epochs. Across 29 hours they post four signed work packets in a sparrow role, spaced at least 6 hours apart, then after a 90-minute dusk gap they audit one randomly assigned neighbor in a raven role. Three unclustered peers rehash the packet chain against the row index and the deposit. A missed window, a reused /24, or a failed audit burns 0.26 POA and freezes that row for two epochs.
